staff.title: Add staff member
staff.assignmentHint: Ask an admin for other roles or stores
staff.emailHelper: Used to log in, receive the initial password and reset a forgotten password.
staff.emailHelperNoLogin: Used for contact and account recovery only. The account can't log in yet.
staff.usernameHelper: Same as the email by default. Can't be changed later.
staff.enableNowHelper: Turn off to create a disabled account.
staff.loginOnHelper: An initial password is emailed to them. They log in with it and then set their own password.

created.title: Account created
created.headline: Account created
created.description: {{name}} now shows up in this store's roster and cashier list
created.descriptionDisabled: {{name}}'s account was created as disabled. They'll show up in the roster and cashier list once it's enabled
created.loginDisabledNotice: This staff member can't log in to the app or web yet, and no password email was sent. To change this, turn on "Allow login to the app and web" in Edit profile. When you save, you'll be asked to send a password setup email.
created.inviteSent: Initial password sent to {{email}}. They must change it the first time they log in.
created.inviteFailed: The account was created but the initial password email was not sent: {{reason}}. You can send it again.
created.stepOpenEmail: Find the initial password in the email
created.stepLogin: Log in to the app with their username and initial password
created.stepSetPassword: Set a new password when prompted

adminCreate.title: Add account
adminCreate.usernameHelper: Defaults to the part of the email before @. Can't be changed later.
adminCreate.managerTip: Setting a store to "Manage" automatically gives the Store manager role.
adminCreate.managerAuto: {{count}} "Manage" store(s) selected. They'll get the Store manager role automatically.
adminCreate.passwordEmailUnsupported: For now you can only set the initial password directly. Emailing a password setup code needs backend support; the option will show here once it's ready.
adminCreate.passwordHelper: 6–100 characters. Share it in person or through a secure channel.

passwordErrors.tooShort: The password needs at least 6 characters
passwordErrors.tooLong: The password can be at most 100 characters
passwordErrors.mismatch: The two passwords do not match

adminCreate.rolesSheetHint: The Store manager role comes from "Manage" stores, so it's not listed here.
adminCreate.optionsLoadFailed: Could not load the options. Please try again later.
adminCreate.uncertain: The result of the create request was not confirmed (network timeout or server error). The account may already exist. Tap "Check result" first and do not submit again.
adminCreate.storesFailed: The account was created (step 1 done), but the "Manage" store settings weren't saved (step 2 failed). Profile and roles are saved. Tap "Retry saving stores" (it won't create the account again), or set it later on the Access page.
adminCreate.verifyFound: An account with this username already exists. Open it to check the details; if they're correct, there's no need to create it again.
adminCreate.verifyNotConfirmed: This account wasn't found and the result is still unconfirmed. Check again later or contact an admin.
adminCreate.verifyFailed: Could not check. Please try again later.
adminCreate.noAccess: You don't have permission to add accounts
adminCreate.passwordNotice: You set the initial password and no email is sent. Share it in person or through a secure channel.
adminCreate.storesPendingNotice: The account was created, but its "Manage" stores weren't saved. Check and set them on the Access page, or they won't get the Store manager role.
adminCreate.stepLogin: Log in to the app with their username and the initial password you set
adminCreate.stepChangePassword: Change to their own password soon after logging in

edit.noAccess: You don't have permission to edit profiles
edit.selfBlocked: You cannot edit your own profile here
edit.accountHint: The username can't be changed after the account is created.

emailErrors.taken: This email is already used by another account. Use a different email.

edit.emailEmptyHint: No usable email yet. Add one so password emails can be sent to them.
